mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger economic expansion boosts corporate earnings and investor risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-4.0% unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in core CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy response to inflation, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery phase, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, rising HOUST (monthly growth > 0.5%) does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits decline.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 95.0, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS monthly change is positive, the 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An annual core CPI growth rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate central bank policy responses supporting growth.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual growth exceeds 2.5%, the 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals strong manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 105.0, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
